detail.command: set -euo pipefail; DEV=$(xcrun devicectl list devices | grep 'iPhone 15 Pro Max' | grep -Eo '[0-9A-Fa-f]{8}-[0-9A-Fa-f]{4}-[0-9A-Fa-f]{4}-[0-9A-Fa-f]{4}-[0-9A-Fa-f]{12}' | head -1); test -n "$DEV"; APP=/tmp/WeatherFlowDeviceIcon/Build/Products/Debug-iphoneos/WeatherFlow.app; test -d "$APP"; xcrun devicectl device install app --device "$DEV" "$APP"; xcrun devicectl device process launch --device "$DEV" com.cornel.deleteweather; sleep 2; xcrun devicectl device info processes --device "$DEV" | grep WeatherFlow
